title: Retire unsupported CUDA/MKL product routes and clear complete dependency policy without exceptions
goal: Retire unsupported CUDA and MKL product feature routes across first-party manifests, build/install scripts, and runtime configuration while retaining CPU inference and hardware discovery without cargo-deny exceptions (landed in 2201c81e1f7cd5d823f9b16ab4db21c2921031b6..b01a15e4202d3fd9f7843ba43108907725f66211 with primary implementation commit fa658800f751a8947abf76336e61cb8d92b42f72; crates/susi-vendor-candle later migrated to Commercial susi-gpu-fabric in 71d7a90bd1583487deb7a7c46ce597bdd53557df).
notes: Integrated on main across 2201c81e1f7cd5d823f9b16ab4db21c2921031b6, fa658800f751a8947abf76336e61cb8d92b42f72, 536c8430d2297093db9676f7182974c76c5b38ce, a8a7b9c484eda8fbf32c39c23ddb1988d65b26a3, 9759d5301e8ff733a71d75897bf6ae607635fd20, a306a027d173a69d198f911201ffafe3b0157ef4, and b01a15e4202d3fd9f7843ba43108907725f66211. Pruned deleted/migrated legacy paths (.github/workflows/*, crates/susi-vendor-candle migrated to Commercial susi-gpu-fabric in 71d7a90bd1583487deb7a7c46ce597bdd53557df, crates/susi-gawd/src/admin/*, src/cli/crown_cli.rs, tests/ci_cached_tool_install.rs, xtask/tests/release_first_artifact.rs) and bound accept.cmd to susi-gemi-models hardware unit tests.

reuse.justification: Retained CPU inference and HardwareProfiler hardware discovery across susi-gemi-models and susi-gemi while retiring unsupported CUDA and MKL product feature routes in place.
